index_method: small manifests and graph JSON only; metadata hashes reused; no STK/NPZ load/large-file rehash

settings.weight_rule: duration = end - start; no task generation, slicing, rescheduling within access or reward reassignment
settings.edge_rule: order u,v by (start,id); edge iff (same antenna and start_v < end_u + ground_gap) or (same satellite and start_v < end_u + satellite_gap); all overlaps including containment are conflicts
settings.horizon_contact_policy: keep only unmodified full contacts fully contained in the planning horizon; retain crossing intervals separately
settings.tick_note: fixed serialization only; not a statement of orbital accuracy; do not coarsen to manufacture feature equality; check integer overflow

contact_csv.meaning_zh: 来源组；同母库所有站网、gap、状态和恢复请求必须同组划分
物理族标识 / 重新传播的物理实现标识
规划起点及轨道历元；relative seconds的零点
完整接触唯一标识 / 卫星—站点流的原始过境序号
卫星实体；同时通信容量为1；也是owner
站点 / 单副天线资源标识
权威端点；9位小数；不裁切、不整数秒化；区间[s,e)
严格等于冻结CSV的end−start；唯一收益，无业务权重
辅助人工显示；STK默认毫秒显示，不能代替权威相对端点
仅raw/boundary表：传播padding边界上可能被截断；不得作为完整规划接触

完整接触时长；无重新赋权
owner=卫星的索引映射；不构成全天团
位1=同天线冲突，位2=同卫星冲突；3=同时满足两类
